commands: git branch --show-current; echo "---PRs---"; gh pr list --search "1200 in:body" --state open --json number,headRefName 2>/dev/null; echo "---base---"; scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main 2>/dev/null; echo "---session---"; echo "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-none}"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
gh issue view 1200 --json title --jq '.title' > .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-1200-title.txt
scripts/branch-for-issue.py --title-file .prflow/tmp/devflow-issue-1200-title.txt --issue 1200

DOCS_LABELS=$(scripts/config-get.sh .docs.labels Documented); echo "labels: [$DOCS_LABELS]"
scripts/apply-labels.sh 1290 "$DOCS_LABELS" 2>&1
scripts/workpad.py update 1200 --tick-progress "Documentation" 2>&1 | tail -1
grep -n "_PROFILE_REQUIRED\s*=" scripts/verification-flight.py; sed -n "$(grep -n '_PROFILE_REQUIRED\s*=' scripts/verification-flight.py | head -1 | cut -d: -f1),+12p" scripts/verification-flight.py

echo "=== checkout fingerprint ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py 2>&1
echo "=== reception-record ==="; scripts/reception-record.py --help 2>&1 | head -25

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
